title: Keep the EO repository seed usable when Git selects a reftable ref backend
outcome: The opt-in immutable EO Git seed remains a valid private repository even when host Git initialization defaults to reftable; it either explicitly selects the supported files backend for the seed or handles the selected backend coherently.
acceptance: The seed initialization and allowlisted snapshot agree on the ref backend without changing global Git configuration or sharing writable metadata; the existing artifact matrices retain all cases and real Git/source captures.
